editorial.blurb: A vibrant food hall tucked inside the beautifully restored Old Post Office, offering everything from street tacos and NYC pizza to BBQ bowls and smoothies.
editorial.insiderTip: Enter from the north side of the building and walk straight ahead—signage is sparse, but you'll quickly spot the vendors. If you're catching an Amtrak, arrive early to beat crowds and enjoy the clean restrooms.
signatureDishes: BBQ bowl with cauliflower, beans and rice, mac and cheese, and pickled vegetables

topDishes.note: made from scratch with tons of flavor
